Sorry, I didn't know where to put this.

 

When my friends and I purchased the base game (before the enhanced edition), each deck came in a plastic, resealable bag. We've had the game for about 3 months now, and we still use them.

Our Infernal Relics, Ambuscade, and Unity came in today, and they didn't have this packaging. I'm just wondering if someone knows where I could get some? The ziploks they're in now takes up WAY too much space, especially if we want to get Rook City and put it in there too.

 

~Shadow
